entries.text: The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves from 30.27.0.1 to 30.29.0.1 (fork commit `6fd92da9333e`), rebased onto upstream SQLGlot v30.29.0 with every carried patch retained. Across 103,170 translations of the shipped benchmark queries from DuckDB, PostgreSQL and Netezza into all 38 targets, no output changes.
